claim: A list circulating in October 2026 names people connected to Jeffrey Epstein who have died. These entries cover 2025 and 2026. Official rulings are attributed to whoever made them. (1) Virginia Giuffre, the most prominent public accuser of Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, died at her farm in Neergabby, Western Australia, in April 2025, at 41. Western Australia police said the circumstances were not suspicious, and her family said she died by suicide. Her father said there was "no way" she took her own life. In December 2019 she had posted: "I am making it publicy known that in no way, shape or form am I sucidal." (2) Umar Dzhabrailov, a Chechen-born businessman and former Russian senator, was found with a gunshot wound to the head in a Moscow residential complex on March 2, 2026, at 67. Russian media, citing police, reported a suicide; he had attempted suicide in 2020. May 2001 emails in the DOJ Epstein release show him arranging to host Maxwell in Moscow, with Maxwell writing that "Jeffrey Tom and I are coming next week." (3) Daniel Siad, a French modeling scout, was found dead at his home in Colombes outside Paris on July 20, 2026, at 69. Prosecutors ordered an autopsy, and no cause has been announced. Several women had accused him of rape and of recruiting them for Epstein, which he denied. In June he told CNN he believed Epstein was a casting director for Victoria's Secret. A May 2016 email in the release from an attorney for Epstein's accusers says Jean-Luc Brunel described Siad as a "scout" or recruiter of girls and/or women for Epstein. (4) Simon Andriesz, a former executive at the brokerage BGC Partners who gave the House Oversight Committee correspondence between Epstein and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, was found dead outside Bangkok on September 23, 2026.
